section: SECTION 1: NATURE, LEGAL IDENTITY AND FOUNDATIONAL HERITAGE
content:
### SECTION 1: NATURE, LEGAL IDENTITY AND FOUNDATIONAL HERITAGE
1.1 **Legal Entity & Registration:**  
Mahaveer Educational & Charitable Trust (MECT / MAHAVIR TRUST) is an irrevocable public charitable trust registered under the Indian Trusts Act, 1882 at the District Sub-Registrar Office, Balangir, Odisha (Book No. 4, Volume No. 45, Document Deed No. 40311302194, executed 27-07-2013, registered 30-07-2013).

1.2 **Founding Leadership & Honorary Governance:**  
- **Settler Founder & Managing Trustee:** Er. Japabandhu Kampa.
- **Founding Life Trustees:** Yudhisthir Rana, Ramachandra Biswal, Sambit Kumar Dang.
- **Deed Clause XVI (Honorary Non-Remunerative Service):** All trustees serve in an honorary capacity without drawing any salary, sitting fee, commission, or personal remuneration from Trust funds. 100% of public and institutional contributions are dedicated to charitable programs.

1.3 **Geographic Mandate:**  
The Trust operates with registered headquarters in Balangir, a corporate secretariat in Bhubaneswar, and an operational mandate covering all 30 districts of Odisha:
- Western Odisha: Balangir, Nuapada, Sambalpur, Bargarh, Jharsuguda, Deogarh, Subarnapur, Sundargarh.
- Coastal & Central Odisha: Khordha, Cuttack, Puri, Kendrapara, Jagatsinghpur, Jajpur, Nayagarh, Dhenkanal, Angul.
- Northern & Eastern Odisha: Balasore, Bhadrak, Mayurbhanj, Kendujhar.
- Southern Odisha: Ganjam, Gajapati, Kandhamal, Boudh, Kalahandi, Rayagada, Nabarangpur, Koraput, Malkangiri.

section: SECTION 2: FOUR CORE GROUND OPERATIONAL PILLARS (2013–2024)
content:
### SECTION 2: FOUR CORE GROUND OPERATIONAL PILLARS (2013–2024)
2.1 **Remedial Rural Education (Balangir & Puintala Blocks):**  
Providing free evening remedial tutoring in Mathematics, Science, and English for Class 6–10 students from economically challenged agrarian families to prevent high school dropouts. Over 350+ students actively supported across rural clusters.

2.2 **Women's Vocational Training & Tailoring School:**  
Empowering rural women, single mothers, and school dropouts with 6-month certified vocational stitching, garment construction, and pattern-making skills. Over 120+ women trained and equipped for dignified home-based or micro-enterprise self-reliance.

2.3 **Jal Seva — Heatwave Potable Drinking Water Relief:**  
Operating free, hygienic earthen pot water kiosks across critical transit nodes (bus stands, railway stations, government hospital perimeters) in Western Odisha during severe 45°C+ summer heatwaves. Over 10,000+ pedestrians, commuters, and daily-wage laborers served annually.

2.4 **Jan Ahar — Hospital Patient Attendant Nutrition:**  
Distributing hygienic subsidized or free meals to underprivileged patient attendants outside District Headquarters Hospital (DHH) Balangir, ensuring families facing medical distress do not go hungry.

section: SECTION 3: 100% DIRECT DISBURSAL STANDARD & ZERO CASH POLICY
content:
### SECTION 3: 100% DIRECT DISBURSAL STANDARD & ZERO CASH POLICY
3.1 **Direct-to-College Tuition Remission:**  
All higher education scholarship subsidies are remitted directly to the verified institutional bank account of the accredited university, college, or polytechnic (payable to Bursar, Registrar, or Principal).

3.2 **Strict Zero Cash Policy:**  
The Trust strictly prohibits the disbursement or handling of physical currency. No cash, bearer cheques, or private bank account transfers are ever made to individual students, parents, relatives, or guardians under any circumstances.

3.3 **Zero Intermediaries & Anti-Commission Mandate:**  
The Trust employs zero educational agents, brokers, commission liaisons, or third-party fee collectors. Applications and appraisals are conducted directly with students and accredited colleges.

3.4 **100% Free Application Standard:**  
All scholarship applications, eligibility screenings, and counseling services provided by MECT are completely free of charge (₹0). The Trust never charges any application, prospectus, or processing fee.

section: SECTION 4: EDUCATIONAL SCHEMES & SCHOLARSHIP PATHWAYS
content:
### SECTION 4: EDUCATIONAL SCHEMES & SCHOLARSHIP PATHWAYS
4.1 **Mahavir Shiksha Protsahan Yojana:**  
- **Objective:** Direct tuition fee assistance for meritorious undergraduate and diploma students from economically challenged households in Odisha.
- **Coverage:** Accredited Bachelor's degree (BA, BSc, BCom, BTech, BCA, BBA) and State Council Polytechnic Diploma programs.
- **Mechanism:** Direct fee transfer to the college upon institutional admission or semester fee demand note verification.

4.2 **Pratibha Excellence Fellowship:**  
- **Objective:** Merit-based study stipend and competitive examination support for high-achieving graduates preparing for national and state competitive examinations (UPSC Civil Services, OPSC, GATE, UGC-NET, CAT).
- **Inclusions:** Academic mentorship, sponsored test series, and specialized study reference books.

4.3 **Project Samarth: Community Learning Centers:**  
- **Objective:** Grassroots community study hubs equipped with quiet reading halls, electricity, high-speed digital connectivity, and competitive reference libraries.
- **Phasing:** Pilot launch in Balangir and Khordha districts, followed by phased expansion.

section: SECTION 5: ELIGIBILITY & SELECTION BENCHMARKS
content:
### SECTION 5: ELIGIBILITY & SELECTION BENCHMARKS
5.1 **Domicile Requirement:**  
Applicants must be permanent bona fide residents of Odisha (verified through permanent residence certificate or documented schooling history in Odisha).

5.2 **Academic Merit Benchmark:**  
Candidates are expected to hold a minimum 60% aggregate in 10th, 12th, or diploma examinations (or equivalent CGPA). Special relaxation benchmarks may be designated by the Trustee Board for disadvantaged candidates.

5.3 **Economic Need Criteria:**  
Need-based priority is given to households with annual family income under ₹2,50,000/- per annum, verified through an official Income Certificate issued by a competent Revenue Authority (Tahasildar / Revenue Inspector).

5.4 **Blind Appraisal & Equity:**  
Candidate appraisals combine academic consistency and financial need evaluation conducted without demographic or geographic bias.

1.3 **भौगोलिक दायरा (30 जिले):**  
ट्रस्ट पूरे ओडिशा के सभी 30 जिलों में शिक्षा, कौशल विकास और नागरिक राहत के लिए समर्पित है।

### SECTION 2: चार मुख्य जमीनी सेवा स्तंभ (2013–2024)
2.1 **ग्रामीण उपचारात्मक शिक्षा (बलांगीर एवं पुईंतला):**  
कक्षा 6 से 10 के 350+ ग्रामीण छात्रों को शाम के समय गणित, विज्ञान और अंग्रेजी की मुफ्त कोचिंग।

2.2 **महिला व्यावसायिक सिलाई एवं स्वावलंबन केंद्र:**

2.3 **जल सेवा — ग्रीष्मकालीन पेयजल राहत:**  
पश्चिमी ओडिशा की भीषण 45°C+ गर्मी में बस स्टैंड, रेलवे स्टेशन और अस्पतालों के बाहर प्रतिवर्ष 10,000+ नागरिकों को शीतल व स्वच्छ पेयजल।

2.4 **जन आहार — अस्पताल मरीज तीमारदार पोषण:**  
जिला मुख्यालय अस्पताल (DHH) बलांगीर के बाहर गरीब मरीजों के परिजनों को पौष्टिक भोजन सहायता।

doc_title: ମହାବୀର ଟ୍ରଷ୍ଟ (MECT) — ପ୍ରାମାଣିକ ସାମ୍ବିଧାନିକ ନିୟମାବଳୀ
section: SECTION 1: ଟ୍ରଷ୍ଟର ସ୍ୱରୂପ ଏବଂ ମୂଳ ଉଦ୍ଦେଶ୍ୟ
content:
### SECTION 1: ଟ୍ରଷ୍ଟର ସ୍ୱରୂପ ଏବଂ ମୂଳ ଉଦ୍ଦେଶ୍ୟ
1.1 **ଆଇନଗତ ପରିଚୟ:**  
ମହାବୀର ଏଜୁକେସନାଲ ଆଣ୍ଡ ଚାରିଟେବୁଲ ଟ୍ରଷ୍ଟ (MECT / MAHAVIR TRUST) ୨୦୧୩ ମସିହାରେ ବଲାଙ୍ଗୀର ସବ୍-ରେଜିଷ୍ଟ୍ରାର ଅଫିସରେ (ଡିଡ୍ ନଂ 40311302194) ପଞ୍ଜୀକୃତ ଏକ ସାର୍ବଜନୀନ ଧର୍ମାର୍ଥ ଟ୍ରଷ୍ଟ। ଏହାର ପ୍ରତିଷ୍ଠାତା ତଥା ମ୍ୟାନେଜିଂ ଟ୍ରଷ୍ଟି ଇଂ. ଜପବନ୍ଧୁ କମ୍ପା। ଆଜୀବନ ଟ୍ରଷ୍ଟିଗଣ ହେଲେ ଯୁଧିଷ୍ଠିର ରଣା, ରାମଚନ୍ଦ୍ର ବିଶ୍ୱାଳ ଏବଂ ସମ୍ବିତ କୁମାର ଡାଙ୍ଗ।

1.2 **ମାନଦେୟବିହୀନ ସେବା (Clause XVI):**  
ଟ୍ରଷ୍ଟ ଦଲିଲର ଧାରା XVI ଅନୁସାରେ ସମସ୍ତ ଟ୍ରଷ୍ଟି ଅବୈତନିକ ଭାବେ ସେବା ପ୍ରଦାନ କରନ୍ତି। କୌଣସି ଟ୍ରଷ୍ଟି ବ୍ୟକ୍ତିଗତ ଦରମା ବା କମିଶନ ନିଅନ୍ତି ନାହିଁ।

1.3 **ଭୌଗୋଳିକ କ୍ଷେତ୍ର (୩୦ଟି ଜିଲ୍ଲା):**  
ଟ୍ରଷ୍ଟ ଓଡ଼ିଶାର ସମସ୍ତ ୩୦ଟି ଜିଲ୍ଲାରେ ଶିକ୍ଷା ଓ ସାମାଜିକ ବିକାଶ ପାଇଁ କାର୍ଯ୍ୟ କରେ।

section: SECTION 2: ୪ଟି ମୁଖ୍ୟ ପ୍ରତ୍ୟକ୍ଷ ସେବା କାର୍ଯ୍ୟକ୍ରମ (2013–2024)
content:
### SECTION 2: ୪ଟି ମୁଖ୍ୟ ପ୍ରତ୍ୟକ୍ଷ ସେବା କାର୍ଯ୍ୟକ୍ରମ (2013–2024)
2.1 **ଗ୍ରାମୀଣ ଉପଚାରମୂଳକ ଶିକ୍ଷା (ବଲାଙ୍ଗୀର ଓ ପୁଇଁତଳା):**  
ଷଷ୍ଠରୁ ଦଶମ ଶ୍ରେଣୀର ୩୫୦ରୁ ଊର୍ଦ୍ଧ୍ୱ ଗରିବ ଛାତ୍ରଛାତ୍ରୀଙ୍କୁ ମାଗଣା ସନ୍ଧ୍ୟାକାଳୀନ ଗଣିତ, ବିଜ୍ଞାନ ଓ ଇଂରାଜୀ ଶିକ୍ଷାଦାନ।

2.2 **ମହିଳା ସିଲେଇ ଓ ବୃତ୍ତିମୂଳକ ପ୍ରଶିକ୍ଷଣ:**  
୧୨୦ରୁ ଅଧିକ ଗ୍ରାମୀଣ ମହିଳା ଓ ସ୍ୱୟଂ ସହାୟକ ଗୋଷ୍ଠୀ ସଦସ୍ୟାଙ୍କୁ ୬ ମାସିଆ ପ୍ରମାଣପତ୍ରପ୍ରାପ୍ତ ସିଲେଇ ତାଲିମ ପ୍ରଦାନ।

2.3 **ଜଳ ସେବା (ଗ୍ରୀଷ୍ମକାଳୀନ ଜଳଛତ୍ର):**  
ପଶ୍ଚିମ ଓଡ଼ିଶାର ଭୟଙ୍କର ଖରାରେ ପ୍ରତିବର୍ଷ ୧୦,୦୦୦ରୁ ଊର୍ଦ୍ଧ୍ୱ ପଥିକ ଓ ଶ୍ରମିକମାନଙ୍କୁ ବିଶୁଦ୍ଧ ପାନୀୟ ଜଳ ଯୋଗାଣ।

2.4 **ଜନ ଆହାର (ଡାକ୍ତରଖାନା ଖାଦ୍ୟ ସେବା):**  
ବଲାଙ୍ଗୀର ଜିଲ୍ଲା ମୁଖ୍ୟ ଚିକିତ୍ସାଳୟରେ ଗରିବ ରୋଗୀଙ୍କ ସହାୟକମାନଙ୍କୁ ପୁଷ୍ଟିକର ଖାଦ୍ୟ ସହାୟତା।

section: SECTION 3: ୧୦୦% ସିଧାସଳଖ କଲେଜକୁ ପ୍ରଦାନ ଏବଂ ସମ୍ପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ ନଗଦବିହୀନ ନୀତି (ZERO CASH POLICY)
content:
### SECTION 3: ୧୦୦% ସିଧାସଳଖ କଲେଜକୁ ପ୍ରଦାନ ଏବଂ ସମ୍ପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ ନଗଦବିହୀନ ନୀତି (ZERO CASH POLICY)
3.1 **ସିଧାସଳଖ କଲେଜ ବ୍ୟାଙ୍କ ଖାତାକୁ ଫିସ୍ ପ୍ରଦାନ:**  
ଟ୍ରଷ୍ଟ ଦ୍ୱାରା ପ୍ରଦତ୍ତ ସମସ୍ତ ଉଚ୍ଚଶିକ୍ଷା ଛାତ୍ରବୃତ୍ତି ଅର୍ଥ କେବଳ ସମ୍ପୃକ୍ତ ସ୍ୱୀକୃତିପ୍ରାପ୍ତ କଲେଜର ଅଫିସିଆଲ୍ ବ୍ୟାଙ୍କ ଖାତାକୁ ସିଧାସଳଖ ପ୍ରେରଣ କରାଯାଏ।

3.2 **କଠୋର ନଗଦବିହୀନ ନୀତି (Zero Cash Policy):**  
ଟ୍ରଷ୍ଟ କୌଣସି ପରିସ୍ଥିତିରେ ବି କୌଣସି ଛାତ୍ର, ଛାତ୍ରୀ ବା ଅଭିଭାବକଙ୍କୁ ନଗଦ ଟଙ୍କା ଦିଏ ନାହିଁ।

3.3 **କୌଣସି ଦଲାଲ ବା ମଧ୍ୟସ୍ଥି ନାହାନ୍ତି (Zero Intermediaries):**  
ସମସ୍ତ ଆବେଦନ ସମ୍ପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ ମାଗଣା (₹0)। କୌଣସି ଦଲାଲ ବା ଏଜେଣ୍ଟ ନାହାନ୍ତି।
